name: Frederick S. Chung
title: Judge, Santa Clara County Superior Court; confirmed nominee to the California Court of Appeal, Sixth Appellate District
years_of_service: Santa Clara County Superior Court since 2018 (appointed by Gov. Jerry Brown October 11, 2018). (Santa Clara County Superior Court)
background: Chung earned his undergraduate degree and J.D. from Harvard. He clerked for Judge Karen Nelson Moore of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit, then practiced at Morrison & Foerster and became a partner at Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher. (Santa Clara County Superior Court)

Gov. Jerry Brown appointed him to the Santa Clara County Superior Court on October 11, 2018. Gov. Newsom nominated him to the Sixth District Court of Appeal on August 7, 2026, and the Commission on Judicial Appointments confirmed him unanimously on August 19, 2026. If voters approve him on November 3, he succeeds Justice Adrienne M. Grover on January 4, 2027. (Governor's office; California Courts Newsroom)
